results.description: Erica (Thorp) de Berry to Thorp family, 15 June 1918 (3b60afa3-3f20-46ff-9e23-ffd21cfe89a6)
results.text: Manuscript letter Archives Number: 1006/004.006.002-006#025 June 15, 1918 Dearest Family, I’m sorry I wrote you such a gloomy letter last week. It would have been better not to write at all, but I was afraid you might think I’d gone up to Paris and got hit by a shell. The news has been so wonderfully cheering this week, and the American gains so magnificent, ^that all is cheerful^. How thrilling it must be, too, for you all at home to get word of it! I can imagine what it must mean after [p. 2]  Erica (Thorp) de Berry to Thorp family, 15 June 1918 (3b60afa3-3f20-46ff-9e23-ffd21cfe89a6)
